author: nickyeow

english.text: Are you free on Tuesday?

jyutping: nei5 sing1 kei4 ji6 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3？
text: 你星期二得唔得閒呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Many economists are ignorant of that fact.

jyutping: hou2 do1 ging1 zai3 hok6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dou6 ne1 joeng2 je5。
text: 好多經濟學家都唔知道呢樣嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What is still better is that the house has a beautiful garden.

jyutping: gang3 gaa1 zing3 ge3 hai6 gaan1 uk1 zung6 jau5 jat1 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 faa1 jyun4。
text: 更加正嘅係間屋仲有一個好靚嘅花園。

author: nickyeow

english.text: There are hundreds of books in his study.

jyutping: keoi5 gaan1 syu1 fong4 jau5 gei2 baak3 bun2 syu1。
text: 佢間書房有幾百本書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm trying hard, but can't think of her name.

jyutping: ngo5 nam2 gik6 dou1 nam2 m4 hei2 keoi5 giu3 me1 ming4。
text: 我諗極都諗唔起佢叫咩名。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Hmm. I have a feeling I'm going to get lost whichever road I take.

jyutping: m4。ngo5 jau5 jyu6 gam2 ngo5 haang4 bin1 bin1 dou1 wui5 dong6 sat1 lou6。
text: 唔。我有預感我行邊邊都會蕩失路。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you leave now, I'm sure you'll be caught in a traffic jam.

jyutping: nei5 ji4 gaa1 ceot1 mun4 hau2，sat6 sak1 ce1 laa1。
text: 你而家出門口，實塞車啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Playing golf is great fun.

jyutping: go1 ji5 fu1 kau4 hou2 hou2 waan2 gaa3。
text: 哥爾夫球好好玩㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: His older brother passed away last month.

jyutping: keoi5 go3 aa3 go1 soeng5 go3 jyut6 gwo3 zo2 san1。
text: 佢個阿哥上個月過咗身。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Anyone over eighteen years of age counts as an adult.

jyutping: so2 jau5 sap6 baat3 seoi3 ji5 soeng6 ge3 jan4 dou1 syun3 hai6 daai6 jan4。
text: 所有十八歲以上嘅人都算係大人。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The car crashed into the guard-rail and rolled down the hill.

jyutping: gaa3 ce1 zong6 zo2 maai4 go3 laan4 gon1 dou6，luk1 zo2 lok6 saan1。
text: 架車撞咗埋個欄杆度，碌咗落山。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sunday is the last day of the week.

jyutping: sing1 kei4 jat6 hai6 jat1 go3 lai5 baai3 leoi5 min6 ge3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 jat6。
text: 星期日係一個禮拜裏面嘅最後一日。

author: tigro1973

english.text: The boy is jumping.

jyutping: go2 naam4 zai2 tiu3 gan2。
text: 嗰男仔跳緊。

author: cc_neko

english.text: You're quite right.

jyutping: nei5 jau6 ngaam1 ge3。
text: 你又啱嘅。

author: kaenif

english.text: I give you plenty of money each month.

jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 bei2 hou2 do1 cin4 nei5。
text: 我每個月俾好多錢你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't like your girlfriend.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 nei5 tiu4 neoi5。
text: 我唔鍾意你條女。

author: nickyeow

english.text: There is a little milk left in the bottle.

jyutping: go3 zeon1 jap6 min6 zung6 jau5 siu2 siu2 ngau4 naai5 zing6。
text: 個樽入面仲有少少牛奶淨。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We cannot allow these people to steal our jobs.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 ni1 di1 jan4 coeng2 ngo5 dei6 faan6 wun2。
text: 我哋唔可以俾呢啲人搶我哋飯碗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Eeny, meeny, miny, moe, catch a tiger by his toe, if he hollers let him go, eeny, meeny, miny, moe. My mother told me to catch the very best one and you are not it.

jyutping: dim2 zi2 bing1 bing1 dim2 zoek6 seoi4 jan4 zou6 daai6 bing1。
text: 點指兵兵點着誰人做大兵。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He's a member of the school football team.

jyutping: keoi5 hai6 zuk1 kau4 haau6 deoi6 ge3 deoi6 jyun4。
text: 佢係足球校隊嘅隊員。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: Tell me, where are you?

jyutping: gong2 bei2 ngo5 teng1 nei5 hai2 bin1 aa3？
text: 講畀我聽你喺邊呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Obviously not!

jyutping: gang2 hai6 m4 hai6 laa1！
text: 梗係唔係啦！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom is still uncertain about whether to go to college or not.

jyutping: aa3 Tom zung6 mei6 kyut3 ding6 duk6 m4 duk6 daai6 hok6 hou2。
text: 阿Tom仲未決定讀唔讀大學好。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Are you suggesting that we impersonate policemen?

jyutping: nei5 hai6 mai6 soeng2 ngo5 dang2 baan6 caai1 lou2 aa1？
text: 你係咪想我等扮差佬啊？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I'm not as good at speaking French as you think I am.

jyutping: ngo5 gong2 faat3 man4 mou4 nei5 jam6 ge3 gam3 hou2。
text: 我講法文無你恁嘅咁好。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Do you understand French?
Do you know French?

jyutping: sik1 m4 sik1 faat3 man4 aa1？
text: 識唔識法文啊？

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: Why are they suppressing this story?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 keoi5 dei6 jiu3 aat3 zai3 ni1 go3 gu3 si6？
text: 點解佢哋要壓制呢個故事？

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Near yonder narrow road stands an old knight's castle; thick ivy creeps over the old ruined walls, leaf over leaf, even to the balcony, in which stands a beautiful maiden. She bends over the balustrades, and looks up the road. No rose on its stem is fresher than she; no apple-blossom, wafted by the wind, floats more lightly than she moves. Her rich silk rustles as she bends over and exclaims, 'Will he not come?'

jyutping: hai2 go2 tiu4 zaak3 lou6 fu6 gan6，jau5 jat1 zo6 gu2 lou5 ge3 ke4 si6 sing4 bou2；keoi5 waan1 hai2 laan4 gon1 soeng6 min6，mong6 zyu6 tiu4 lou6。 mou5 jat1 do2 mui4 gwai3 hai2 keoi5 ge3 ging3 soeng6 gang1 san1 sin1 gwo3 keoi5； mou5 ping4 gwo2 faa1，bei6 fung1 piu1 joeng4，fau4 dak1 bei2 keoi5 ji4 dung6 gang1 hing1。 dong1 keoi5 waan1 dai1 san1 haam3：「keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4 me1？」go2 zan6，keoi5 tiu4 fung1 fu3 ge3 si1 cau4 saa1 saa1 saa1 seng1。
text: 喺嗰條窄路附近，有一座古老嘅騎士城堡；佢彎喺欄杆上面，望住條路。 冇一朵玫瑰喺佢嘅莖上更新鮮過佢； 冇蘋果花，被風飄揚，浮得比佢移動更輕。 當佢彎低身喊：「佢唔會嚟咩？」嗰陣，佢條豐富嘅絲綢沙沙沙聲。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Saying "I love you" in Kabyle is not as easy as in French and English since the expression "ḥemmleɣ-kem", strangely resembling the Polish formula "Kocham Cię" is not so fluid, phonetically speaking. In Russian, it is even more laborious as it is said "Ya tibya lyublyu" (Я тебя люблю)". Finally, the main thing is to claim it with sincerity.

jyutping: hai2 kaa1 bei2 ji5 man4 jap6 min6 gong2「ngo5 oi3 nei5」m4 wui5 hou2 ci5 faat3 man2 tung4 jing1 man2 gam3 jung4 ji6，jan1 wai6「ḥemmleɣ-kem」ni1 go3 biu2 daat6 fong1 sik1，kei4 gwaai3 gam2 leoi6 ci5 bo1 laan4 ge3 gung1 sik1「Kocham Cię」，hai2 jam1 jik6 soeng6 mou5 gam3 lau4 coeng3。hai2 ngo4 man2 jap6 min6，zau6 gang3 gaa1 san1 fu2 di1，jan1 wai6 keoi5 waa6 hai6「Ya tibya lyublyu」(Я тебя люблю)，zeoi3 hau6，zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 hai6 jiu3 zan1 sing4 gam2 sing1 cing1 keoi5。
text: 喺卡比爾文入面講「我愛你」唔會好似法文同英文咁容易，因為「ḥemmleɣ-kem」呢個表達方式，奇怪噉類似波蘭嘅公式「Kocham Cię」，喺音譯上冇咁流暢。喺俄文入面，就更加辛苦啲，因為佢話係「Ya tibya lyublyu」(Я тебя люблю)，最後，最重要嘅係要真誠噉聲稱佢。
